word: Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice.
meaning: 不要讓他人意見的喧囂淹沒你內心的聲音。
example: He urges them not to let other people's views silence the voice inside themselves.
hint:
中文解釋：精彩的「噪音vs.內心聲音」對比——外在的聲音是噪音，內在的才是真實的你。
1) drown out (phr.): 淹沒、蓋過；syn: silence; ant: amplify
2) inner voice (n.): 內心的聲音；syn: intuition; ant: external opinion
pronunciation: Protective: Don't let the NOISE of OTH-ers' O-pin-ions | DROWN OUT | your OWN in-ner VOICE.

word: And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
meaning: 最重要的是，要有勇氣去追隨你的心和直覺。
example: Above all else, he urges them to be brave enough to trust and act on their own instincts.
hint:
中文解釋：整段「follow your heart」建議的核心句——需要的不只是熱情，還有「勇氣」。
1) most important (phr.): 最重要的；syn: above all; ant: least important
2) intuition (n.): 直覺；syn: gut feeling; ant: logic
pronunciation: Climactic: and MOST im-PORT-ant | have the COU-rage | to FOL-low your HEART and in-TU-i-tion.

word: They somehow already know what you truly want to become.
meaning: 它們以某種方式已經知道你真正想成為什麼樣的人。
example: Your heart and intuition already contain the answer to who you are meant to be.
hint:
中文解釋：賦予「心與直覺」神秘的洞察力——它們比你的理智更了解你真正的渴望。
1) somehow (adv.): 以某種方式；syn: in some way; ant: clearly
2) truly want to become (phr.): 真正想成為的；syn: deepest aspiration; ant: what others want for you
pronunciation: Mysterious: They SOME-how AL-ready KNOW | what you TRU-ly want | to be-COME.

example: Compared to following your heart, nothing else matters as much.
hint:
中文解釋：乾脆有力的總結——把「追隨內心」置於人生一切之上，其他的都是次要考量。
1) everything else (phr.): 其他所有事情；syn: all other matters; ant: this alone
2) secondary (adj.): 次要的；syn: less important; ant: primary
pronunciation: Final: Eve-ry-thing ELSE | is SEC-ond-ar-y. (falling tone, definitive)

word: When I was young, there was an amazing publication called The Whole Earth Catalog, which was one of the bibles of my generation.
meaning: 在我年輕的時候，有一本令人驚嘆的刊物叫做《全球概覽》，它是我那一代人的聖經之一。
example: He describes The Whole Earth Catalog as one of the most important and inspiring publications of his era.
hint:
中文解釋：引出最後的故事——《全球概覽》是一本代表那個理想年代精神的特殊刊物。
1) publication (n.): 出版物；syn: magazine; ant: (n/a)
2) bible (n.): 聖經（比喻：最重要的參考書）；syn: essential guide; ant: trivial book
pronunciation: Nostalgic: when I was YOUNG | an a-MA-zing pub-li-CA-tion | called the WHOLE EARTH CAT-a-log | one of the BI-bles.

word: It was created by a fellow named Stewart Brand, not far from here in Menlo Park.
meaning: 它是由一位名叫斯圖爾特·布蘭德的人創辦的，就在距離這裡不遠的門洛帕克。
example: Stewart Brand, who lived nearby in Menlo Park, was the creator of this remarkable publication.
hint:
中文解釋：對Stanford學生有地理親切感——「not far from here」讓這段歷史更有真實感。
1) fellow (n.): 傢伙、人（口語）；syn: man; ant: (n/a)
2) Menlo Park (n.): 門洛帕克（加州城市，鄰近Stanford）；syn: nearby town; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Local: STEW-art BRAND | not FAR from HERE | in MEN-lo PARK.

word: And he brought it to life with his poetic touch.
meaning: 他用他詩意的筆觸讓它栩栩如生。
example: Stewart Brand gave the publication a unique and poetic quality that made it come alive.
hint:
中文解釋：強調《全球概覽》不只是資訊彙整，而是有靈魂的創作——「poetic touch」說明其藝術性。
1) brought to life (phr.): 賦予生命、讓…栩栩如生；syn: animated; ant: made dull
2) poetic touch (n.): 詩意的筆觸；syn: artistic flair; ant: plain style
pronunciation: Warm: he BROUGHT it to LIFE | with his po-ET-ic TOUCH.

word: This was in the late sixties, before personal computers and desktop publishing, so it was all made with typewriters, scissors, and Polaroid cameras.
meaning: 那是在六○年代末期，在個人電腦和桌面排版出現之前，所以一切都是用打字機、剪刀和寶麗來相機做出來的。
example: In an era without computers, the publication was created using only basic tools like typewriters and scissors.
hint:
中文解釋：時代背景的細節——沒有電腦，全靠雙手，對比今天的數位時代更顯珍貴。
1) desktop publishing (n.): 桌面排版（電腦排版）；syn: digital layout; ant: manual production
2) Polaroid cameras (n.): 寶麗來即拍相機；syn: instant cameras; ant: digital cameras
pronunciation: Historical: late SIX-ties | be-fore PER-son-al COM-pu-ters | type-WRIT-ers | SCI-ssors | Po-la-ROID CAM-er-as.
